Verse of the Day
For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
Obadiah 1:15
Quote of the Day
"Jesus Christ … knows and loves each of us perfectly and invites us to walk with Him, abide in Him, and follow His example."
President Dallin H. Oaks | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
